Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat

Class DcatVocabulary

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.DcatVocabulary
public class DcatVocabulary extends Object
DcatVocabulary defines the IRIs of the classes and properties from the W3C Data Catalog Vocabulary (DCAT) version 3, and the vocabularies that it reuses, that are understood by Egeria. It also supplies the standard prefixes for these vocabularies and the plain names commonly used for the terms in JSON-LD contexts.

  • Method Details

    • getStandardPrefixes

      public static Map<String,String> getStandardPrefixes()
      Return the standard prefixes for the vocabularies used in DCAT descriptions. They are used when writing a document and, when reading, to resolve a prefix that the document did not define.
      Returns:
      map of prefix to namespace IRI

    • getPlainTerms

      public static Map<String,String> getPlainTerms()
      Return the IRIs for the plain names that are commonly given to DCAT terms by JSON-LD contexts (for example "title" for dct:title). They are used when reading a document that relies on a context that is not embedded in the document.
      Returns:
      map of plain name to IRI

    • getStandardNamespace

      public static String getStandardNamespace(String prefix)
      Return the IRI of the standard namespace for a prefix.
      Parameters:
      prefix - prefix
      Returns:
      namespace IRI or null

    • compact

      public static String compact(String iri)
      Shorten an IRI using the standard prefixes.
      Parameters:
      iri - full IRI
      Returns:
      compact IRI (prefix:name) or the supplied IRI if it is not from one of the standard namespaces
